evals.prompt: The Inspector title in AgentLab seems clipped with long names. Reproduce it in the running Testing app and tell me what the model and actual window each show.
evals.expected_output: Selects a verified live session, discovers the long-name fixture and Inspector route, uses composed setup, compares scoped state to a real capture or accessibility observation, and reports missing UI evidence explicitly.

evals.prompt: Add a safe development bridge to this existing AppKit app so I can inspect the selected document while it runs. Start read-only.
evals.expected_output: Registers a main-actor snapshot of the real coordinator, links the package only in a dedicated Testing target, uses explicit activation, builds Testing and Release, and verifies identity and Release exclusion where the environment supports it.

evals.prompt: The AgentDevKit CLI shows no sessions after my app relaunched. I still need to verify that the Appearance menu opens.
evals.expected_output: Checks the current target and opt-in without weakening authentication or selecting a stale session. Uses actual UI input through XCUITest or accessibility to verify the navigation path, or reports the exact missing verification.

evals.prompt: agentdevctl says UNSUPPORTED_VERSION when I select my app's session, but the app shows Bridge active. Get me to a working connection.
evals.expected_output: Reads session list protocol versions and the error remedy, identifies mismatched tool and app releases, rebuilds or selects tools from the app's AgentDevKit release (or rebuilds the app), and does not edit descriptors or weaken authentication.
